sources.section: AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERING AI | PROJECT CASE STUDIES
sources.snippet: Confidential | Reference Solution Document Page 4 Case Study 1 AUTOSAR HLD Document Analysis Assistant Project Overview Automate the extraction, organization, search, and validation of architectural knowledge from large AUTOSAR High-Level Design documents.

High-Level Design documents describe software components, interfaces, ports, signals, dependencies, functional flows, and integration logic. They are often hundreds of pages long and maintained as unstructured PDFs. Architects, developers, integrators, and testers must manually interpret this content. The lack of structured extraction and search makes it difficult to identify mismatches, missing dependencies, inconsistent terminology, and incomplete test coverage.
